name: Bulgaria

elections.note: Run-off between Iliana Iotova and Andrey Gyurov. First round 25 October 2026 (CIK, 95.29% of protocols): Iotova 34.59%, Gyurov 32.03%.
elections.noteIs: Seinni umferð milli Iliönu Iotovu og Andrey Gyurov. Fyrri umferð 25. október 2026 (CIK, 95,29% kjörgagna): Iotova 34,59%, Gyurov 32,03%.

leaders: President Iliana Iotova; Prime Minister Rumen Radev (Progressive Bulgaria)
leadersIs: Iliana Iotova forseti; Rumen Radev forsætisráðherra (Framsækin Búlgaría)
summary: Iliana Iotova led the first round on 25 October with 34.59% against 32.03% for Andrey Gyurov (preliminary CIK count), so the two meet in a run-off on 1 November. Turnout was about 22%, according to parallel-count estimates, and official results are due from the CIK on 27 October.
summaryIs: Iliana Iotova var efst í fyrri umferðinni 25. október með 34,59% en Andrey Gyurov fékk 32,03% (bráðabirgðatölur CIK), svo þau mætast í seinni umferð 1. nóvember. Kjörsókn var um 22% samkvæmt áætlunum úr samhliða talningu og CIK birtir opinber úrslit 27. október.

lastElection.outcome: No candidate won a majority; preliminary CIK figures (95.29% of protocols) put Iliana Iotova on 34.59%, Andrey Gyurov on 32.03% and Kostadin Kostadinov on 12.6%, on a turnout of about 22% by parallel-count estimates.
lastElection.outcomeIs: Enginn frambjóðandi fékk meirihluta; samkvæmt bráðabirgðatölum CIK (95,29% kjörgagna) fékk Iliana Iotova 34,59%, Andrey Gyurov 32,03% og Kostadin Kostadinov 12,6%, en kjörsókn var um 22% samkvæmt áætlunum úr samhliða talningu.
